symptom: lumpy deformed fingers that had grown over years
hook: the hand was studded with bubbly bone lumps and little round stones in the soft tissue
whatYouSee: Multiple lytic expansile enchondromas fill the small bones of the hand and round calcified phleboliths sit in the soft tissues.
whyItMatters: It is a non-hereditary mix of multiple enchondromas and soft tissue hemangiomas and it carries a markedly raised lifetime risk of turning malignant into chondrosarcoma.
treatment: There is no cure; management is surveillance for malignant change, correction of deformity or fractures, and excision of any lesion that grows or becomes painful.
takeaway: Bone lumps plus little round stones in the soft tissue of the hand is Maffucci syndrome and it needs lifelong cancer watch.
